description: Source code for Scrum module in an OpenERP/Odoo project, defining classes for Scrum teams, projects, sprints, backlogs, tasks, and meetings with associated methods and fields.

classes.name: scrum_team
classes.description: Defines a Scrum team with a name and associated users.

classes.name: scrum_project
classes.description: Extends project.project with Scrum-specific fields like product owner, tasks, sprint size, and hierarchy.

classes.name: scrum_sprint
classes.description: Represents a Scrum sprint with methods to calculate progress, effective hours, and planned hours.

classes.name: scrum_product_backlog
classes.description: Represents a product backlog with methods to compute progress, effective hours, and planned hours.

classes.name: scrum_task
classes.description: Extends project.task with Scrum-specific backlog association and method to update project based on backlog.

classes.name: scrum_meeting
classes.description: Represents a Scrum meeting with fields for agenda and date.

methods.name: _calc_progress
methods.description: Calculates progress percentage based on backlog or task hours and progress.

methods.name: _calc_effective
methods.description: Calculates total effective hours from backlog or task hours.

methods.name: _calc_planned
methods.description: Calculates total planned hours from backlog or task hours.

methods.name: onchange_project_id
methods.description: Updates product owner, Scrum master, and end date when project is changed in sprint.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Custom search for backlog items by sprint ID.

methods.name: onchange_backlog_id
methods.description: Updates project ID based on selected backlog item.
